Weng.Modeler
Class Toolpath

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--Weng.Modeler.Toolpath
public class Toolpath
extends java.lang.Object

Use this singleton class to create 'toolpath' entities, that is, features whose contained entities reference a tool and whose geometry is used to drive the tool during cutting processes.

With regards to offset direction, it suggested that you use the constants Const.LEFT and Const.RIGHT that are define in Weng.System.Const. Otherwise, offset direction follows protractor convention (+) LEFT / (-) RIGHT. For the uniformed, offset direction is relative to arc direction.

With regards to cut direction, it suggested that you use the constants Const.CCW and Const.CW that are defined in Weng.System.Const. Otherwise, arc direction follows protractor convention (+) CCW / (-) CW.

Method Detail

Profile

public static DbFeature Profile(DbProfile dbProfile,
                                DbTool dbTool,
                                int offsetDirection,
                                double wallAllowance,
                                double sharpAngle,
                                double zLevel)
This method is analogous to the machining menu item known as Create/Associate. Given appropriate input parameters, this method will create profiling toolpath that is associated with a given profile entity.
Parameters:
dbProfile - the reference profile entity
dbTool - the tool entity that will be used
offsetDirection - the side of the reference profile towards which the resulting offset toolpath should be created
wallAllowance - a signed delta offset distance (also known as stock allowance). By default, the offset distance is taken as the radius of the tool. The wall allowance value is added to the default offset distance.
sharpAngle - controls the insertion of blending radius between adjacent curves in the resulting offset profile. A blend radius be inserted into the offset profile when the interior angle between the corresponding adjacent reference curves is less than the specified angle (degrees). For instance, given a square reference profile and a sharpAngle of 90 degrees, the resulting offset profile will not contain any blending arcs. If the sharpAngle is 90.01 degrees the resulting offset profile will contain four blending arcs.
zLevel - the elevation of the resulting toolpath geometry
Returns:
(null) indicates failure / (else) the resulting toolpath feature

Spiral

public static DbFeature Spiral(DbProfile dbProfile,
                               DbTool dbTool,
                               double stepOverDistance,
                               double wallAllowance,
                               int cutDirection,
                               boolean insideOut,
                               double sharpAngle,
                               double passDepth,
                               double floorAllowance)
This method is analogous to the machining menu item known as Create/Pocket. Given appropriate input parameters, this method will create 'spiral' pocketing toolpath that is associated with a given profile entity.
Parameters:
dbProfile - the reference profile entity
dbTool - the tool entity that will be used
stepOverDistance - the lateral separation between adjacent offset passes in the resulting toolpath.
wallAllowance - a signed delta offset distance (also known as stock allowance). By default, the offset distance is taken as the radius of the tool. The wall allowance value is added to the default offset distance.
cutDirection - the sense of forward cutting progression (Const.CCW, Const.CW)
insideOut - the sense of lateral cutting progression. (true) cut from the inside of the pocket towards the outside / (false) cut from the outside of the pocket towards the inside.
sharpAngle - controls the insertion of blending radius between adjacent curves in the resulting offset profile. A blend radius be inserted into the offset profile when the interior angle between the corresponding adjacent reference curves is less than the specified angle (degrees). For instance, given a square reference profile and a sharpAngle of 90 degrees, the resulting offset profile will not contain any blending arcs. If the sharpAngle is 90.01 degrees the resulting offset profile will contain four blending arcs.
passDepth - the vertical separation between planar cutting regions
floorAllowance - the stock allowance amount to apply to the floor of the pocket. Note that the floor of the pocket is taken to be the elevation of the reference profile.
Returns:
(null) indicates failure / (else) the resulting toolpath feature

PencilMill

public static DbFeature PencilMill(DbProfile profile,
                                   DbTool dbTool,
                                   int cutSide,
                                   double offsetDist,
                                   double sharpAngle,
                                   double depth,
                                   double clear,
                                   double wallAngle,
                                   boolean nibRemoval,
                                   double distA,
                                   double distB)
Creates 'Pencil Milling' toolpath that cleans up the pocket-floor/wall and wall/wall intersections. Optional nib removal is provided. It is assumed that the top of the material is at Z0. It follows that clearance is a distance above Z0, and depth is a distance below Z0.
Parameters:
profile - the profile representing the outline of the pocket floor.
dbTool - the tool that will be used to cut the material.
cutSide - one of Const.LEFT or Const.RIGHT.
offsetDist - the distance to offset the center of the tool from the profile
sharpAngle - the limiting angle (degrees) of an outside corner. Any outside corner whose interior angle is smaller than this limit will be navigated using a blending arc.
depth - the distance below Z0 at which cutting will take place.
clear - the distance above Z0 to which the tool must move to clean up the wall/wall intersections.
wallAngle - the inclination angle (degrees) of the wall from the vertical.
nibRemoval - determines whether nib-removal movements will be generated.
distA - used during nib-removal, is the distance to move away from the corner.
distB - used during nib-removal, is the distance to move parallel to a wall.

LeadsApply

public static boolean LeadsApply(DbFeature tp,
                                 int leadSetupID,
                                 boolean exterior,
                                 double minOverlap)
Applies lead-in/lead-out moves to the given toolpath feature as directed by the lead parameters associated with the given setup id.
Parameters:
tp - the toolpath feature to which the leads will be applied
leadSetupID - the id of the lead setup parameters in the cmdb
exterior - (true) the given toolpath represents exterior cuts (false) the given toolpath represents interior cuts.
minOverlap - the minimum overlap distance. This value is used when the product of the distance factor and the tool tip diameter is less that the specified minimum overlap distance.
